title: TaskAttemptsOutput
description: Output of `gentry task attempts --json` without an attempt: the attempts of a task. With an attempt the command gives that attempt as `gentry task show --json` gives a task (TaskShowOutput).

task.description: Identifier of the task, such as SHOP-1.

attempts.description: Attempts of the task in order, from 1; a task never cancelled has one.

state.description: State of the attempt, as in Task.

taken.description: Time the attempt was taken in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

ended.description: The closing or the cancelling of the attempt; absent while it is in work.
